items.body_raw: בֶּן־הַמֶּלֶךְ
items.answer_raw: The son of the king

items.body_raw: וַיִּקַּח אֶת־בְּנוֹ
items.answer_raw: He took his son.

items.body_raw: אָחִי אַתָּה
items.answer_raw: You are my brother.

items.body_raw: בַּת־פַּרְעֹה
items.answer_raw: Pharaoh's daughter

items.body_raw: הָאִישׁ בַּשָּׂדֶה
items.answer_raw: The man is in the field.

items.body_raw: וְשָׁב אֶל־הַמַּחֲנֶה
items.answer_raw: And he returned to the camp.

items.body_raw: בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת
items.answer_raw: Sons and daughters

items.body_raw: בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל
items.answer_raw: The sons of Israel

items.body_raw: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי־אָדָם אַחֲרֵי הוֹלִידוֹ אֶת־שֵׁת שְׁמֹנֶה מֵאֹת שָׁנָה וַיּוֹלֶד בָּנִים וּבָנוֹת
items.answer_raw: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

items.body_raw: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־חָם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם בְּגוֹיֵהֶם
items.answer_raw: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

items.body_raw: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־שֵׁם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִלְשֹׁנֹתָם בְּאַרְצֹתָם לְגוֹיֵהֶם
items.answer_raw: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

items.body_raw: וְאַבְרָהָם בֶּן־מְאַת שָׁנָה בְּהִוָּלֶד לוֹ אֵת יִצְחָק בְּנוֹ
items.answer_raw: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

items.body_raw: וַיָּבֹא יְהוּדָה וְאֶחָיו בֵּיתָה יוֹסֵף וְהוּא עוֹדֶנּוּ שָׁם וַיִּפְּלוּ לְפָנָיו אָרְצָה
items.answer_raw: Judah and his brothers came to Joseph's house, and he was still there. They fell on the ground before him.

items.body_raw: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רָחֵל אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד לְיַעֲקֹב כָּל־נֶפֶשׁ אַרְבָּעָה עָשָׂר
items.answer_raw: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: all the souls were fourteen.

items.body_raw: וּבְנֵי־דָן חֻשִׁים
items.answer_raw: The son of Dan: Hushim.

items.body_raw: וְרָחֲצוּ מִמֶּנּוּ מֹשֶׁה וְאַהֲרֹן וּבָנָיו אֶת־יְדֵיהֶם וְאֶת־רַגְלֵיהֶם
items.answer_raw: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

items.body_raw: וְאַהֲרֹן בֶּן־שָׁלֹשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים וּמְאַת שָׁנָה בְּמֹתוֹ בְּהֹר הָהָר
items.answer_raw: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

items.body_raw: מִמִּשְׁפְּחֹת בְּנֵי־מְנַשֶּׁה בֶן־יוֹסֵף הָיוּ לְנָשִׁים וַתְּהִי נַחֲלָתָן עַל־מַטֵּה מִשְׁפַּחַת אֲבִיהֶן
items.answer_raw: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

items.body_raw: זֹאת נַחֲלַת בְּנֵי־גָד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם הֶעָרִים וְחַצְרֵיהֶם
items.answer_raw: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.

items.body_raw: וַעֲזַרְיָהוּ בֶּן־עוֹדֵד הָיְתָה עָלָיו רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים
items.answer_raw: The Spirit of God came on Azariah the son of Oded.

items.body_raw: בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים וּשְׁתַּיִם שָׁנָה יְהוֹרָם בְּמָלְכוֹ וּשְׁמוֹנֶה שָׁנִים מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם
items.answer_raw: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.

items.body_raw: בֶּן־עֶשְׂרִים וְחָמֵשׁ שָׁנָה הָיָה בְמָלְכוֹ וְשֵׁשׁ־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה מָלַךְ בִּירוּשָׁלִָם
items.answer_raw: He was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
